_help: 3D models for armor, by Desi (CC0, see CREDITS.md). 'skinned' GLBs carry the 65-bone UAL2 skeleton (same bone names / rest pose as the zombies) and no animations: parent the MeshInstance3D(s) under a UAL2 Skeleton3D (skeleton = that node) to wear them. 'display' GLBs are unskinned and centred for the character screen (T-pose shapes). slot_pieces maps data/armor.json slots to pieces; class_item has two looks, class_item_by_class picks one per class (fallback = first). Use ArmorModels (scripts/world/armor_models.gd) to read this.
